result: failed after the single prespecified fallback (500k tokens, 16 epochs)

issue: the outcome-blind B11 check (HB/HF and HB/HU ratios of time-averaged realized mean displacement on the tuning units) was not implemented before the S1 finals were declared; it was noticed and run while S1 finals were in progress (30 of 108 complete)
inputs: budget_trace fields of the S1 tuning run records only (realized TV per layer and epoch); no dev or test metric read
consequence: none for the S1 finals: the rule would not have triggered recalibration, so the finals use the parameters the protocol prescribes; the deviation is only in timing
fix: select.py levels now runs the check (manipulation_check.py) before any finals are declared and stops if recalibration is required; S2 will be checked on time

issue: the RB (relaxed_budget) LM arm does not fit the 3.21 GiB of free VRAM at batch 32; it was not benchmarked before the freeze
decision: run RB and E3 DB LM arms with per-block activation checkpointing; mathematically and numerically identical on the probe (bit-identical loss and gradients); wall-clock for these arms is not comparable and is reported from the matched eager benchmark only

issue: S2 DK (DropKey with linear depth schedule) ran without the schedule in 3 tuning runs; the S2 level choice and C*_L were computed from them
decision: exclude the 3 runs (reported, never analysed), rerun them with the fixed runner, and re-apply the prespecified selection rule. The superseded decision (DK@0.20 selected, C*_L = DK@0.20) is kept in excluded/ and disclosed. No test outcome was seen.

rule: PROTOCOL A section 4 hard cap (90 GPU-h or 12 days after the freeze)
issue: the 12-day calendar limit (freeze 2026-09-25T15:08:58Z, so the limit was 2026-10-07T15:08:58Z) expired while the campaign was paused at the authors request; the last completed run before the limit finished at 2026-10-04T08:22:15.047721+00:00. Remaining declared extensions: E-S3 phase L (34 of 50 runs), E5, E4, E1, E3.
decision: the authors extended the calendar limit; the 90 GPU-hour cap remains binding and every extension still starts only if its full cost fits. The limit was exceeded through wall-clock pauses (laptop availability), not extra compute.
disclosure: stated in the paper (Limitations, Deviations); runs completed after the calendar limit are identifiable from their ledger timestamps
